deep_analysis:

Both SHORT, aligned with the tape: BTC 1m has been below EMA300 for 621+ consecutive minutes (80628 vs 81310, gap widened to -0.84% from -0.16% last cycle), linreg BEAR on 1m/5m/15m/1h, trend_quality STRONG_DOWN.

CFX SHORT #16373 (+3.9%, 4.25h): stop 0.05058178 has trailed in and locks +3.08% — worst case is a win. Fresh-open test: YES, would open fresh — meta_rsi 36.2 sits in the <40 band which runs 62.5% WR (n=8, +0.07, 7d) because a STRONG_DOWN tape carries oversold shorts. Entry thesis intact, no change: hold. TP 0.04960714 needs another -1.14% while CFX 1h ATR is ~0.83% — the stop, not the TP, is the plan. Exit condition (re-tested at write time from continuum 23:14:39 + BTC 1m closes 80545-80708): BTC 1m closes hold ABOVE EMA300 (now 81310, re-read from data each cycle) for 15-30m -> take trail profit; down-tape thesis gone. Condition NOT met as of 23:15 — prior cycle's steer stands, age=2 cycles unexecuted. If CFX reclaims 0.05058 first, the stop exits at +3.08% automatically.

BTC SHORT #16377: just opened, 0.00. Precheck advisory was FAIL (LOSERS list, coin_shame WR<55%, death-zone meta_rsi 47.6) — reported per standing CEO-bracket rule, not hidden. Real R:R 1.23 (risk 551pts / reward 679pts). SL 0.59% away, TP 0.93% away into the 79800-80116 demand. Condition keys: TP only on fresh breakdown momentum (1h range already 80513-81390 — -0.93% is a full 1h-range extension); if momentum stalls, the 8h max-hold time-exit is the accepted exit, NOT a resting deep TP. Invalidation: BTC 1m reclaims EMA300 81310 and holds 15-30m -> thesis dead, SL 81180 does its job within 0.6%.

Portfolio: 2/6 slots, 22.2 USDT net short, no longs. Both positions win on a BTC dump and both die on a squeeze — correlated-consistent, not hedged, fine while the tape stays below EMA300; combined stops cap loss at ~+profit for CFX and -0.55 for BTC. No capital-efficiency problem: 4 slots idle, but aggregate 5m reads 123/129 SHORT_BIAS (96% one-sided) with zscore -2.02 — a stretched tape where adding MORE shorts is the crowded trade; idle slots are acceptable this cycle.

24h: 22 closes, 50% WR, -0.15 USDT. LONG 33% WR -0.24 (fought STRONG_DOWN), SHORT 61.5% +0.09 (right side). The volume-buildup- 4-loss streak in steer-002 is BROKEN — SYRUP/MON/DYDX/ICP all won 22:25-22:38 (signal window now 70% WR, +0.39). Do not disable on the stale streak; the real bleed is the 40-55 RSI entry band (see pattern_alerts).

Watchlist pick this cycle: NEAR SHORT conf 72 (rsi_at_pick 58.0, price 4.611) — AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False, PICK (watchlist only, will NOT execute). Precheck PASS all gates; NEAR regime SHORT_BIAS conf 95, -3.47%/15m, 1h -2.87%, RSI 58 in the 55+ winning band (n=17, 52.9% WR, +0.64).
regime_context:
Sources disagree — always cite which: aggregate 5m = SHORT_BIAS (123 short / 1 long / 5 neutral of 129 tokens = 96% one-sided, regime_5m 23:15:01); regimes.BTC 15m = SHORT_BIAS (was NEUTRAL last cycle); btc_15m summary = SHORT_BIAS; btc_4h = LONG_BIAS; continuum = BELOW EMA300 (price 80628 vs 81310, -0.84%, consecutive_below 621 min, last cross ~12:53 UTC); linreg_direction BEAR all timeframes, alignment 1.0; zscore_tier STRONG_NEG (-2.02); wyckoff MARKDOWN; trend_quality STRONG_DOWN; market_phase RECOVERY; volatility NORMAL.

Flip rate (measured this cycle): aggregate 28 flips/24h, BTC 15m 13 flips/24h (96 dumps). 28 >= p95 (26) = the unstable tail — a direction state survives ~51 min on average, so snapshot directional prose is unreliable; every direction-flavored call in this file is condition-based (keyed to BTC 1m vs EMA300 81310 and the aggregate scan, re-read and re-tested next cycle) per the retraction rule. Low-churn <6 flips (real trend tape) has not occurred since Oct 2 — not today's situation.

Stretched-tape warning: 96% of tokens short-biased + zscore -2.02 + 10h below EMA300 means the down move is crowded and extended. Trend-following still says stay with shorts (that is where the edge measured: SHORT 61.5% WR 24h vs LONG 33%), but a mean-reversion squeeze up would hit both open positions within 0.6-0.8% — hence conditions on every steer, not fixed levels, and no new short entries added at 96% breadth.
pattern_alerts:
Verified in PostgreSQL this cycle (meta_rsi = _signal_metadata->'rsi_14', never entry_rsi_14):

PATTERN A — LONGs against a down tape (n=9, 24h): LONG 33.3% WR, -0.24 USDT vs SHORT 61.5%, +0.09. LONG losers: GRASS (pump-chain+, rsi 60.8, atr_sl_hit), PUMP (r2v2-long9, rsi 65.3), POLYX (bb-bounce-v2, hard_sl -0.14, no meta_rsi), WLFI (bb-bounce-v2, rsi 57.1, hard_max_loss), ME (bb-squeeze, rsi 74.7, trail_arm_timeout), BTC x2 (ai-trader-pending, UNIVERSAL_MAX_HOLD). WINNING side in those exact windows: shorts — same 24h gave WLD +0.11, DYDX +0.16, MON +0.12, LTC +0.09, ICP +0.04 all trail-won while those longs died. Why weren't we on it: bounce/squeeze/pump-chain signals fired longs while BTC 1m was below EMA300 with STRONG_DOWN trend quality. Condition (re-test next cycle, not a blanket kill): hold LONG entries while (BTC 1m below EMA300 AND aggregate 5m SHORT_BIAS).

PATTERN B — SHORT entry-RSI dead band (7d, meta_rsi, n=37 total): 40-45 = n4, 25% WR, -0.22; 45-55 = n8, 25% WR, -0.18; combined dead zone 40-55 = n12, 25% WR, -0.40. The two WINNING bands: <40 = n8, 62.5% WR, +0.07 (trend-carried oversold shorts in STRONG_DOWN — CFX/DYDX/ICP/SYRUP pattern) and 55+ = n17, 52.9% WR, +0.64 (short into strength BEFORE the dump). Why weren't we on it: volume-buildup- fired 4 shorts at meta_rsi 35-43 inside 3h (11:46-14:54: ALT/ME/ZRO/CC, -0.54 combined) — entries after the dump already happened, mid-band chop with no direction to carry the trail; all chop exits (hard_max_loss x2, cut-loser, stale_exit). The WINNING side at those moments: short earlier at RSI 55+ when strength was still there, or cash — mid-band chop has no winning direction. Flag for brain auditor to band-filter signal params (watchdog does not change params). Note the precheck 'death zone' advisory (45-55) matches this measurement — 40-45 is also dead per data (n4, small).

PATTERN C — BTC conditional/pending orders pay no rent (n=5, 24h): 16353/16358/16356... three BTC trades all exited UNIVERSAL_MAX_HOLD for -0.02/-0.03 after 8-29h of capital, plus auto_trader shadow n=8 in CHOP: longs 0/4 (-0.11), shorts 3/4 (+0.123), overall 37.5% WR. The WINNING side of BTC chop: short-side only (shadow shorts 75% WR), long-side zero. Why weren't we on it: conditional BTC orders were armed in both directions (BRACKET) and the long arm kept filling against the down tape. #16377 short is the right arm this time — but it carries the same death-zone RSI 47.6 precheck FAIL noted in its steer.

LOW-N OBSERVATION (auditor verify before action): 7d LONG meta_rsi band edge at 72+ (n=7, 71% WR, +0.07) vs documented sweet spot 45-60 (n=42, 36% WR, -0.04) from prior cycle — today's HBAR (72.9) and YGG (75.0) wins consistent. Single window, no p-value, n=7 — do not tune to it yet.
